name: print-social-3ps-of-marketing-infographic-dark-with-colour-coded-icons
title: '3P's of Marketing' dark infographic slide with a torn-corner header card and colour-coded icon columns
whatItIs: A dark navy slide with a white header card with a folded top-right corner, a three-column band below in orange, red and green each labelled 'P', connected by vertical lines down to outline icons (box, dollar sign, megaphone) and text blocks for Product, Price and Promotion.
whatItMeans: Structured and presentation-ready; the folded-corner card and colour-coded columns make a classic marketing framework easy to teach.
techniques: Give a header card a folded-corner paper effect.
Connect a coloured band to its icon with a straight vertical line.
Colour-code each of three parallel points differently.

vocabulary.definition: A card design detail suggesting a turned paper corner.
A framework or argument built from exactly three parallel items.
